question: Which universal, tawny, and radiant qualities of Śiva are praised in this salutation?
premises: Śiva is addressed as all gods.
Śiva is addressed as possessing brahmanic splendor.
inference: The salutation honors Śiva’s universality, tawny form, and brahmanic radiance.
plain_english: Obeisance to the one who is all gods, obeisance to the tawny one, obeisance to the one of brahmanic splendor.
